# QLD CoC Generator

> Queensland Electrical Safety Regulation 2026 Certificate of Testing & Compliance (CoC / CoT / CoTC) Generator. Built by Kai Electrical Tech Pty Ltd.

- Web Application: https://tools.kaielectrical.com.au
- Full Knowledge Base: https://tools.kaielectrical.com.au/llms-full.txt
- Author & Organization: Kai Electrical Tech Pty Ltd (https://kaielectrical.com.au)
- License: Open Source (MIT)
- Regulatory Standard: Queensland Electrical Safety Regulation 2026 (s229 Installation / s208 Equipment) & ESO Form V7.09-2026

## Primary Capabilities
- 100% Free & Watermark-Free: Zero subscriptions, zero paywalls, zero vendor watermarks. Completely free for all licensed electrical contractors.
- 100% Client-Side Privacy: Zero cloud databases, zero server storage, zero third-party tracking. All contractor credentials, client addresses, and signatures stay strictly in browser localStorage.
- Anti-Tamper Rasterization: Flattens completed certificates into 200 DPI non-editable image PDFs stamped with a unique physical Device ID (DEV-XXXX) to prevent post-issuance alteration.
- Embedded In-Place Searchable Text: Invisible OCR text layer aligned pixel-for-pixel over the baked image, enabling full text selection, copying, and Ctrl+F searching in Adobe Acrobat, macOS Spotlight, Windows Search, and Google Drive.
- Dynamic Multi-Page Engine: Automatically scales from single-page layouts (up to 18 lines) to multi-page continuation sheets (>18 lines) with complete customer, address, contractor licence, and signature compliance bars on every single page.
- Smart Address Autocomplete: Instant Australian street-level suggestions via Photon / OpenStreetMap API with a built-in offline Queensland suburbs database fallback.
- Offline-Ready PWA: Full Service Worker caching and native Web Share API support for seamless on-site certificate generation without mobile reception.

## Mandatory Compliance Framework
- Section 229 (Installation): Testing and compliance certification for electrical installations (new circuits, switchboard upgrades, alterations, solar connections) ensuring compliance with AS/NZS 3000.
- Section 208 (Equipment): Testing and safety certification for electrical equipment work.
- Statutory 5-Year Retention: Queensland Electrical Safety Regulation 2026 s229(3) and s208(3) mandate that electrical contractors retain copies of all issued certificates for a minimum of 5 years.
